# Erdos.p243 — Erdős problem 243

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/243
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/243.lean`, theorem `erdos_243`, AMS 40).

Let $a_1 < a_2 < \dots$ be a sequence of integers such that
$\lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{a_n}{a_{n-1}^2} = 1$ and $\sum \frac{1}{a_n} \in \mathbb{Q}$.

Then, for all sufficiently large $n \ge 1$, $a_n = a_{n-1}^2 - a_{n-1} + 1$.

## Statement
∀ (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha₀ : StrictMono a)
    (ha₁ : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a n : ℝ) / a (n - 1) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (ha₂ : Summable ((1 : ℚ) / a ·)), ∀ᶠ n in atTop, a n = a (n - 1) ^ 2 - a (n - 1) + 1

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
